articleTitle: Research on Text Classification Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Text classification is one of the research hotspots in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP). In this paper, TextCNN model based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used for classification; the classified corpus is selected from the text extracted from the electronic instruction manual. During the experiment, the text was preprocessed at first, then the processed text was converted intoword vector formatto generate data sets, which were finally input into TextCNN for training. In order to verify the influence of TF-IDF weighted word vectors on training results, data sets made by weighted and unweighted word vectors were used in the comparison experiment to conduct classification model training and to calculate the final accuracy of the model, it is concluded that the classification accuracy can be improved by using weighted word vectors.

articleTitle: Research on SQL Injection Attack and Prevention Technology Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This SQL injection attack is one of the common means for hackers to attack database. With the development of B/S mode application development, more and more programmers use this mode to write applications. However, due to the uneven level and experience of programmers, a considerable number of programmers do not judge the legitimacy of user input data when writing code, which makes the application security risks. Users can submit a database query code and get some data they want to know according to the results of the program. SQL injection attack belongs to one of the means of database security attack. It can be effectively protected by database security protection technology. This paper introduces the principle of SQL injection, the main form of SQL injection attack, the types of injection attack, and how to prevent SQL injection. Discussed and illustrated with examples.

articleTitle: Research on Block Chain Network Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the development of computer technology and the popularization of network, network brings great convenience to colleagues and risks to people from all walks of life all over the world. The data in the network world is growing explosively. Various kinds of intrusions are emerging in an endless stream. The means of network intrusion are becoming more and more complex. The intrusions occur at any time and the security threats become more and more serious. Defense alone cannot meet the needs of system security. It is also necessary to monitor the behavior of users in the network at any time and detect new intrusions that may occur at any time. This will not only make people's normal network needs cannot be guaranteed, but also face great network risks. So that people not only rely on defensive means to protect network security, this paper explores block chain network intrusion detection system. Firstly, the characteristics of block chain are briefly introduced, and the challenges of block chain network intrusion security and privacy are proposed. Secondly, the intrusion detection system of WLAN is designed experimentally. Finally, the conclusion analysis of block chain network intrusion detection system is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-Border E-Commerce Logistics Supply Under Block Chain
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Supply chain is the core link of cross-border e-commerce. The traditional "centralized" supply chain model can no longer meet the development needs of cross-border e-commerce. Based on the block chain technology, this paper studies the logistics supply chain management of cross-border e-commerce. Starting from the core connotation of "decentralization" of block chain, this paper proposes its innovative application from three aspects of logistics, capital flow and information flow. This paper provides new ideas on how to build an efficient cross-border e-commerce logistics supply chain system, improve China's cross-border e-commerce logistics supply chain management ability, and solve the development problems of cross-border e-commerce under the top-level strategy of "One Belt And One Road".

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Neural Network PID Algorithm in Oil Pump Control
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The control system of oil pump generally exists in the steep mountains with harsh environment. The external conditions such as temperature and air pressure will have a great influence on the control system of oil pump. In addition, because the current oil pump system generally adopts PID control, its control effect on the large lag nonlinear system is not very good, and the rise of neural network in recent years is comparable to the non-linear system. This paper combines the advantages of fuzzy control and neural network control, proposes a fuzzy neural network PID control algorithm to control the oil pump system, and makes a detailed analysis of the control performance of the oil pump and the structure model and algorithm implementation of the algorithm. Matlab simulation shows that the algorithm has good effect in overshoot and anti-jamming ability.

articleTitle: Research on CNN to Feature Extractionin Diseases Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the hypertension and Hyperlipidemia prediction study, due to there are some problems with the feature extraction of text-based data in physical examination data. This study proposes the feature extraction using convolutional neural network, and then the gradient lifting tree algorithm establishes the prediction model. The deviation between the prediction result and the actual result is 0.0277. The group prediction bias is 0.0394. Therefore, in the hypertension and Hyperlipidemia prediction, using the convolutional neural network for feature extraction can reduce the prediction bias and improve the prediction effect.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation on Serial Communication Based on Qt
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Serial communication is a very common and stable communication method. This paper introduces the Qt-based serial communication application development program in detail, analyzes the design concept of serial communication software development, and completes the visual interface design of Qt-based serial communication software. The software test results show that the real-time data communication between the two computers can be realized. The operation of the software is simple and convenient, and the design interface is elegant. The test software which has excellent anti-interference ability is stable and reliable.

articleTitle: Based on Surf Feature Extraction and Insulator Damage Identification for Capsule Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Nowadays Capsules network (CapsNet) as alternatives to traditional convolution neural network (CNN) is used for machine learning and image processing direction, in view of the catenary insulator damage problem, the characteristics of the traditional matching algorithms due to its low recognition rate, slow speed of recognition problem, put forward a network based on feature extraction SURF and capsule combined with insulator damage identification algorithm. First, the image was processed by canny edge extraction and direction Angle selection. Then, Hough was used to extract the linear image of the damaged part of insulator. Capsule network was used to train these extracted images and classify the damage level. The loss function of the damaged insulator image identified by this algorithm is only half that of the traditional algorithm, and the interference of the complex background on the hanging string image is greatly reduced, and the time of the capsule network training image is greatly reduced. The experimental results show that this algorithm can recognize the damaged insulator image well, and the recognition rate is up to 99.5%.

articleTitle: Optimization of ICCP Anode Configuration Based on Multi Objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the cathodic protection system, the distance between the anode and the structure is small, the resistivity of the environmental medium is high, and the protection current is high, which may result in uneven distribution of the potential on the structure. Aiming at this problem, based on the anti-corrosion design of long-distance pipeline with impressed current cathodic protection, an optimization model of anode position and anode output current is proposed to reduce the corrosion rate of long-distance pipeline and achieve cathodic protection. The boundary element method (BEM) is used to study the parameter optimization problem of the system based on the multi-objective genetic algorithm of cathodic protection potential distribution model. Then, through the COMSOL Mulitiphysics simulation software combined with genetic algorithm to optimize the anode position and current density, a cathodic protection optimization model that meets the cathodic protection requirements and has a uniform distribution is established. The feasibility of the model and the adaptability of the genetic algorithm in the optimization of anode configuration are verified by comparison with the measured data on site.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Controller Based on PID-NLADRC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To enable quadrotor aircraft to fly autonomously in precise paths and to reduce the influence of quadrotor dynamic model error, this paper proposes a hybrid controller with nonlinear active disturbance rejection control (NLADRC) and PID control for trajectory tracking. Combined with the characteristics of quadrotor aircraft dynamic model, the position controller is designed by PID and to obtain the desired attitude angle information through calculating the desired location information, and then to design the attitude controller by NLADRC for achieving the purpose of tracking expected attitudes. The simulation results indicate that the proposed controller can achieve good trajectory tracking. Compared with the PID controller, the proposed hybrid controller is more robust and has higher tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Research for Vehicle Anti-Rollover Control Based on Differential Braking
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to make up for the shortcomings of the vehicle stability control system in the prevention of rollover control, the vehicle lateral stability is further improved and the stability characteristic of the vehicle rollover resistance is studied. The basic principles of vehicle lateral stability control and the important factors affecting vehicle lateral stability are analyzed. The vehicle simulation model including in the transmission system, braking system and tire model, etc. is established by CarSim software. Based on the differential braking, combining the LTR control principle, a vehicle anti-rollover controller is developed. In the controller, the static threshold method is used to control the vehicle lateral stability. The effectiveness of the anti-rollover control strategy based on the differential braking is verified by the vehicle simulation experiments under the serpentine route.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Data Analysis Based on Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet age, the sales industry has also launched a new networked sales channel through the information network platform. In the network sales platform where all kinds of e-commerce are gathered, the mastery and analysis of various information data can provide accurate data decision analysis for e-commerce. At present, information data analysis systems based on big data and artificial intelligence technology provide data collection, analysis and decision-making to help e-commerce provide more efficient and accurate information services. Based on the e-commerce platform's big data intelligent data processing decision system, the product recommendation and effect of e-commerce concern in the paper are studied, and the collaborative filtering algorithm is adopted to recommend the product for the e-commerce user interest preference. After optimizing the algorithm, the simulation algorithm is compared with the rule algorithm to prove that the effect of this study is more accurate and effective for e-commerce data.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Information Model Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The smart grid is one of the important application areas of artificial intelligence, and the construction of the smart grid system with the characteristics of information physics fusion is also more and more perfect. Based on the complex network theory, this paper modeled and analyzed the topology of the smart grid information network. Firstly, the two indicators of network performance and end-end reliability in the network were used as the reliability evaluation index of the network when being attacked randomly and deliberately, and then the reliability of the constructed smart grid topology and that of a certain power communication network were compared. The final simulation results showed that the reliability of the constructed smart grid information system was greatly improved compared with the traditional power communication network, which can provide useful theoretical reference for information network erection and reliability analysis of smart grid.

articleTitle: Research on Recognition Technology of License Plate Image
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Based on the MATLAB platform, this paper studies the image recognition technology in the license plate recognition system. Firstly, the image is preprocessed by modern computer technology, mainly for grayscale processing of color images, and then stretching and binarization processing at a smooth angle to get image with high precision. Secondly, the license plates decomposed into several independent characters in view of the character segmentation algorithm. Finally, according to the support vector machine and the statistical learning method, the main parameter of the kernel function is determined by the bilinear method. Construct the character classifier by one-to-many method and output the recognition result of the license plate information including Chinese characters, English and numbers. The experimental results show that the proposed method has higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Scale-Free Network User-Side Big Data Balanced Partition Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In view of the time-consuming problem of traditional scale-free network user-side big data balanced partitioning strategy; a new scale-free network user-side big data balanced partitioning strategy is proposed. A scale-free network user-side big data balanced partition model is built, and the iterative rules of the scale-free user-side big data evolutionary game are calculated according to the model. The above rules are used to determine the influence of network size on the evolution of user-side big data, and the traffic balance partition of user-side big data is realized. The experiment was carried out around the problem of time consumption. Comparative experiments show that the proposed scale-free network user-side big data balanced partitioning strategy can effectively solve the problem of time consuming.

articleTitle: Research on FCS-MPC Control of LCL Grid-Connected Inverter Based on Optimized i1-i2-uc Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: By using multivariable model predictive control, the performance of predictive control can be effectively improved. In order to improve the quality of LCL grid-connected inverters based on FCS-MPC, a FCS-MPC control strategy of LCL grid-connected inverters based on optimized i1-i2-uC prediction is proposed. A mathematical model of LCL grid-connected inverters based on three variables prediction of grid-side current, inverter-side current and capacitor voltage in alpha-beta coordinate system is established. The switching vector optimization method is used to reduce the prediction calculation amount and switching loss. The performance of grid-connected inverters under grid balance and unbalanced grid is simulated and verified in detail. The simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control strategy course can effectively improve the quality of grid connection and reduce switching losses.

articleTitle: Stick-Slip Vibration Suppression of Drill String Based on Fractional Order PID
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Stick-slip vibration of drill string system is one of the important reasons leading to damage of drilling tools, decrease of drilling safety and decrease of drilling efficiency. In order to suppress stick-slip vibration and analyze the mechanism of stick-slip vibration, a torsional model of drill string system with four degrees of freedom is established. A fractional order PID controller is designed. The simulation results show that the control effect of the fractional-order PID controller is better than that of the traditional PID controller, which can control the drill string system faster and better, and effectively suppress the stick-slip vibration.

articleTitle: An ESO of ADRC Parameter Setting Method Based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In view of the problems such as the numerous ESO parameters of active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC), its parameter setting difficulty and lack of experience for reference at the present stage, we proposed a PSO-based ESO parameter setting method for ADRC. This method organically combines the good robustness of ADRC with the high efficiency of PSO. Taking a second-order system as an example in a Matlab environment, the ESO parameter setting process of PSO was analyzed by setting appropriate fitness indexes. The results showed that the method could effectively improve ESO's estimation ability for the extended state and meet the performance requirements of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Sub-Channel and Power Control in Heterogeneous Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of power allocation based on energy efficiency in future wireless heterogeneous networks, sub-channel allocation and power control of the entire wireless network are studied respectively. A sub-channel allocation strategy is proposed according to the average allocation power of each sub-channel. Ant colony algorithm is adopted to solve the distributed sub-channel power control problem of heterogeneous networks. Through distributed solution and iteration, until the energy efficiency of the whole wireless network reaches convergence and an optimal solution is obtained, thus realizing the research on the sub-channel power control method of structured networks. The experimental results show that the research based on network sub-channels and power control in heterogeneous networks is better than the existing research results in improving energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Application of NER and MC in Answers Extraction of Factoid Questions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Question answering (QA) system is intended to be fast, simple and accurate to give feedback to the user's natural language questions. By studying answers extraction in the Chinese QA system, this paper adopted the method of combination of the Named Entity Recognition (NER) and the theory of Metric Cluster (MC) to extract answers about factoid questions. These answers extraction experiments used the standard of TREC evaluation, and the factoid questions' average MRR value was 0.6883. These results show that the method had a higher MRR value and good effect on answers extraction.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of Telemetry Data Based on LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the complexity of telemetry sequence data and the long-term dependence on historical data, a method of telemetry data prediction based on LSTM network is proposed, which includes extracting, classifying, scaling and time slicing of raw data to minimize the prediction error. As a goal, from the change law of the data itself, the feature parameter sequence is combined with the original sequence data as the input of the LSTM network model, and the LSTM network model is trained and predicted. By comparing the prediction results of existing network prediction models on various types of parameter datasets, it is verified that the proposed LSTM prediction model has higher accuracy and strong applicability.

Author Keywords: Long and Short Time Memory Network

articleTitle: L2 Control for Networked Control Systems Subject to Denial-of-Service Attacks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the issue of designing L_2 state feedback controller for networked control systems subject to unknown periodic denial-of-service (DoS) jamming attacks. Primarily, a resilient event-triggering mechanism is introduced to counteract the influence of DoS jamming attacks. Secondly, a switching system model of NCSs is set up. Then, the criteria of the exponential stability analysis is obtained by the piecewise Lyapunov functional approach based on the model. Thirdly, a co-design approach of the trigger parameters and L_2 controller is developed. Lastly, a practical system is used for proving the efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on the Resource Shortage Scheme Based on High Availability Cluster
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of big data and artificial intelligence, universities, enterprises, and governments have invested a lot of manpower and material resources to conduct related research. Especially in the transition period of colleges and universities in the cultivation of applied-type skilled talents, the lack of hardware resources led to the study of college teachers staying at the theoretical level. This paper provides how to build a high-availability cluster based on Hadoop environment under the existing conditions of colleges and universities, which effectively solves the problem of shortage of hardware resources for college teachers and provides a simple and convenient way for everyone to obtain a safe high-availability cluster environment of colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on Data Acquisition of Communication Equipment Based On Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the data acquisition accuracy of traditional methods such as GPS data acquisition vehicle, original paper data acquisition and electronic data acquisition is not high; a data acquisition model for the evaluation index of substation communication equipment based on machine learning is proposed. Through the design of data receiving board, the fast data input of substation communication equipment is realized, and the data sampling control card is designed, which is packaged with the sensor head, switching data acquisition device and sampling control card to realize the data acquisition of substation communication equipment evaluation index. Experimental comparison shows that this model is more accurate than three traditional data acquisition models.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Next Generation Internet Address Coding
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve a series of problems in address space and information security of contemporary Internet, Chinese scientists proposed new generation network architecture (IPV9) on the basis of IPv4 and IPv6 research. This paper briefly introduces IPV9 addressing model, address writing, address prefix writing and so on. Compared with IPv4 and IPv6, IPV9 address structure is the most prominent highlight of the IP address length from 32, 128 bits to 2048 bits. At the same time, the method of the variable-length and variable-position is used to reduce the network overhead. In order to solve the network communication security mechanism, the mechanism of first verification and then communication is adopted. Fundamentally solve the problems of insufficient spatial address and information security, and lay a solid foundation for the application and research of the new generation of Internet.

articleTitle: Research on Hierarchical Software Clustering Algorithm Based on Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to better ensure the security and stability of network operation, a hierarchical software clustering algorithm based on wireless network is proposed. Through the collection and analysis of the structural features of wireless network hierarchical software entering and leaving this collection and analysis, the cluster heads of wireless networks of different levels are standardized. In order to ensure the accuracy of calculation results, a node clustering security evaluation metric algorithm is designed, thus realizing accurate calculation of hierarchical software clustering. Finally, the experiment proves that the hierarchical software clustering algorithm based on wireless network has higher accuracy and effectiveness than the traditional algorithm, and can better ensure the network operation safety.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Control for Reactive Power of Electric Drive System of Pump Station
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that reactive power is too high caused by the control method of electric drive system of pump station, an artificial intelligence control method of reactive power of electric drive system of pump station is proposed. The transmission signal of the electric drive system of pumping station is processed by the non-linear operation of proportion, integral and differential through the structure of fuzzy PID algorithm. The transmission signal enters the nonlinear function estimator of the neural network controller, and through the function processing of the inverse process, the nonlinear mapping ability of the neural network is utilized to finally realize the artificial intelligence control. In order to verify the control reaction rate and the optimization effect of the proposed control method, compared with the traditional control method, the simulation comparison experiment and the actual comparison experiment were respectively designed. Experimental results: The simulation comparison experiments show that the control response rate of artificial intelligence control method is better than the traditional control method; the actual contrast experiment shows that the artificial intelligence method can effectively reduce the reactive power of the transmission system and can be popularized.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithms for Enhanced Diversity of Sample Nodes in Electronic Commerce System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The traditional recommendation algorithm for e-commerce has the problems of single product category and inconsistent recommendation products with user preferences, resulting in the lack of diversity and accuracy. An Intelligent Recommendation Algorithm for enhancing diversity of sample nodes in commercial system is proposed. After obtaining the user's past operation records, an attribute of the recommendation target is selected by calculating the constructed user preference matrix. Through user similarity calculation, similar users are screened and specific targets are further screened to achieve the function of recommendation algorithm. In order to verify the accuracy and diversity, a simulation comparison experiment is carried out with the traditional algorithm. Compared with the traditional algorithm, the intelligent algorithm with enhanced diversity of sample nodes in e-commerce system can improve the accuracy and diversity of the two indicators, and can be extended.

articleTitle: Research on Multidimensional Information Security Assessment Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to ensure the security of multi-dimensional information, this paper proposes a research on key technologies of multi-dimensional information security risk assessment based on big data framework. According to the characteristics of multi-dimensional information security data, security division is carried out, intrusion data impact parameters are collected, and intrusion risk budget is carried out according to different impact parameter values and divided security levels, so as to realize accurate evaluation of multi-dimensional information security risks. Finally, the experiment proves that the key technology of multidimensional information security risk assessment based on big data framework has higher practicability and accuracy, and meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-Focus Image Fusion Algorithm Based on Differential Evolution
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: An improved multi-focus image fusion algorithm based on differential evolution is proposed in this paper. The algorithm introduces dual-generation mechanism and adaptive block mechanism. In the evolutionary process, the algorithm generates two descendant populations to preserve the information of parent population, expands the global search range and improves the convergence performance of the algorithm. When the corresponding image blocks' resolution are equal, the image block is decomposed into smaller blocks, and then the small blocks' resolution are compared again. It can obtain better fused image than the original algorithm, and does not change the pixel value of the source image. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm can get better fusion image than the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Decision Support System on Smart Campus
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the continuous development and advancement of Internet technology, building an information management mechanism and a smart campus control model is an inevitable trend in keeping with the times. Among them, the decision support system can provide a more convenient management path for construction work and take advantage of Internet of Things technology and RFID radio frequency technology to ensure that big data management is more convenient and effective. This paper analyzes the characteristics of the smart campus and the overall framework of the decision support system, while focusing on the design and implementation process of the smart campus decision support system for reference only.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Dynamic Load Complementarity Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To solve the problem of unstable prediction results of traditional power load forecasting methods, a power dynamic load complementary coefficient forecasting method based on big data technology is proposed. The prediction method is mainly divided into the following four parts. The data caliber and density are collected to determine the reasonable data range. Then, according to the big data technology, the curve function of charge movement is calculated to calculate the complementary coefficient, and the complementary coefficient is combined to complete the prediction. The experimental results show that the power dynamic load complementarity coefficient prediction method based on big data technology proposed for the traditional charge prediction method is more stable, so this method is more effective.

articleTitle: The Electrical and Thermal Multi-Physical Field Simulation of HVDC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of HVDC transmission technology in China, commutation technology is becoming more and more localized. As the core equipment of the converter station, operation status of the converter valve tower is directly related to the safe and stable operation of the converter station. The valve tower structure of converter station is complex and precise. The electrothermal performance of valve tower under high voltage and high current operation environment is the focus of the engineering designers. In this paper, the three-dimensional electric field simulation model for converter station valve tower is established. The distribution of electric field on valve tower and fittings surface is obtained under operation conditions, and the distance of key discharge path is calculated by flashover checking. Considering eddy current heating under high current conditions, the temperature distribution on complex fittings surface of valve tower is checked and calculated. On the basis of the simulation of electrothermal physical field, the field test of ±500kV valve hall is carried out by using the ultraviolet imager and infrared thermal imager. The results show that the temperature and electric field are the hottest points in the simulation results under the actual operating conditions, which coincide with the field observation position, and prove the validity of the simulation calculation of electrothermal physical field. Based on this, the discharge path of valve hall is checked by electric field using theoretical formula. The research results of paper have certain theoretical guidance value for operation and maintenance of valve hall of converter station, especially for the overheating of valve tower after the capacity of HVDC transmission line is increased, which provides better visual theoretical checking calculation method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Visualization of Website Log Data from the Perspective of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Human society has entered the era of big data in which everything can be digitized, how to efficiently analyze massive data through limited resources is the common requirement of current enterprises to obtain valuable information from complex data. This paper takes the website log data of a consulting company as the research object. SOM and FCM double layer clustering model are used to analyze massive log data efficiently. At the same time, T-sne algorithm is used to reduce the dimensionality of high-dimensional data, and data visualization is realized in the form of two-dimensional graph coordinate diagram. For website maintenance staff more easily understand the network security situation, identify abnormal access and further data analysis to provide ideas.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Big Data Technology in Video Intelligent Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor timeliness and low accuracy of current video intelligent analysis technology, video intelligent analysis was studied in combination with big data technology. Through the use of big data technology and discrete wavelet principle to collect video image information, and calculate the information characteristics and classification transmission processing, according to the information characteristic parameters set video image information intelligent processing rules, so as to complete the intelligent analysis of video. Finally, experiments show that video intelligent analysis using big data technology is significantly better than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent Text Location Based on Multi Model Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to reduce the additional learning burden and efficiency of people when looking for information. This paper mainly combines the prediction results of bagging, random forest and linear regression models, and builds a model to understand natural language problems and retrieve related materials. In the process of building the model, the improved data processing method is used to process the data, and then the data is imported into different models for training. This paper uses the multi-model fusion algorithm to output the predicted results, which can prevent the prediction from over-fitting And improve the accuracy of positioning.

articleTitle: Network Serivce Selection in the Femtocell Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the number of mobile devices growing rapidly in recent years, more and more mobile applications have been downloaded leading to large volume of mobile data. Besides, the indoor mobile users (MUs) often experience poor signal reception problem. Deploying femtocells is considered as a promising technique to address these issues. With more network service providers (NSPs) beginning to deploy femtocells, the femtocell communication markets become competitive. Therefore, how to offer femtocell network services in competitive femtocell communication markets is a pressing problem that NSPs should consider. In this paper, we study network service selection in a femtocell communication system, where two NSPs deploy femtocells to compete to provide better network services. We consider the case that NSP1 has firstly deployed femtocells and begun to provide network service, and the other one NSP2 plans to provide network service after NSP1. Numerical results are performed to evaluate our analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Positioning Technology Based on Multi Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Solving the problem of robot positioning is a key issue in robot research. In recent years, the use of multi-sensor fusion to improve the positioning accuracy of robots has become a trend. The traditional monolithic SLAM algorithm combining IMU and monocular vision sensor solves the problem of monocular SLAM scale uncertainty to some extent. However, there is a problem that the initialization process is unstable and the pure rotation solves the drift. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a SLAM autonomous localization algorithm combining magnetometer, IMU (inertial measurement unit) inertial sensor and monocular vision sensor. It solves the key problems of initialization instability and pure rotation solution drift in the VI-SLAM algorithm.

articleTitle: Routing Algorithm for Reducing Packet Loss in Mobile WSN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSN), sensor nodes have limited energy, and the routing of wireless sensor networks must solve the core problems of reducing power consumption and prolonging the network life cycle. At present, the mainstream of routing protocol is clustering routing protocol, and the most representative routing algorithm of this protocol is LEACH protocol. The traditional LEACH protocol is not suitable for mobile node. LEACH-M protocol is a kind of mobile WSN routing protocol which optimized node movement on the basis of LEACH protocol. This paper proposes a cluster protocol Leach-MON based on mobile WSN for the loss of LEACH-M packets, which adds the idea of on-demand routing to the mobile sensor network. The throughput and energy consumption of the nodes are fully considered, simulation under NS3 Network simulator, and the packet loss was significantly lower than LEACH-M.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Robot Patrol Route Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to better ensure the accuracy of the robot's running path, a cloud computing-based correction method for intelligent robot inspection path is proposed. Firstly, the displacement detection method of the robot inspection path is optimized, so that the movement path is reasonably planned, the standard parameters of the path inspection are obtained according to the path planning result, and the actual movement path parameters of the robot monitored in real time are calculated and compared, and once the comparison error occurs, correction processing is immediately carried out, so that correction processing of the inspection path of the intelligent robot is completed. Finally, the experiment proves that the intelligent robot inspection path correction method based on cloud computing is more effective and reasonable than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Security Technology in Campus Network Construction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The current campus network has become the basic equipment in campus construction. The safe and reliable campus network not only can utilize various resources inside and outside the schoolreasonably, safely and effectively, but also improve the working environment of the campus network, facilitate the management and maintenance of the campus network, and improve the reliability of the campus network. Therefore, it is especially important to build a reasonable campus network security system; Based on the security design in the network construction of a university campus network, this paper analyzes comprehensively the possible security problems, the current security status of campus network and the needs of campus network security. Based on the existing information organization structure of colleges and universities, this paper uses various management methods and technical methods to divide the campus network into various functional area modules, and deploys corresponding solutions in each regional module to solve the network security existing in the campus network. The problem is ultimately to protect the online system resources and services, and to alleviate the security threats of the campus network.

articleTitle: Research of Rice Lodging in Farmland Wind Field Based on CFD
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Combining the performance of stalks of farmland crops such as rice under wind load and self-gravity, a mathematical model of forced vibration and moment balance is established to derive the critical wind speed that the stalk can withstand; Establish a three-dimensional flow field model of farmland and crops, and use FLUENT to calculate the wind speed and wind pressure distribution on the crop surface under the unidirectional wind field, and obtain the position of the crop that is most likely to fall down in the wind; The concept of windshield wall is proposed, then the flow field simulation calculation is carried out on the model, finally the effective measures to reduce wind damage are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Nonlinear Frequency Hopping Communication Under Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor stability and low accuracy of current communication data informatization processing methods, this paper proposes a research on nonlinear frequency hopping communication data informatization under the framework of big data security evaluation. By adding a frequency hopping mediation module to the frequency hopping communication safety evaluation framework, the communication interference information is discretely processed, and the data parameters of the nonlinear frequency hopping communication data are corrected and converted by combining a fast clustering analysis algorithm, so that the informatization processing of the nonlinear frequency hopping communication data under the big data safety evaluation framework is completed. Finally, experiments prove that the research on data informatization of nonlinear frequency hopping communication under the framework of big data security evaluation could effectively improve the accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Intelligent Recovery Based on Power Information System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: Big Data; power engineering computing; Internet; computer network security; Internet of Things; learning (artificial intelligence); electronic commerce; neural nets; security of data; text analysis.

articleTitle: Research and Simulate of Real-Time Particle Systems Based on GPU-Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Study on realistic simulation of natural scenery has always been one of the difficult and focused problems in the field of computer graphics. In order to solve the problem of time-consuming and inaccurate simulation of particle system, this paper proposed a particle system simulation based on GPU acceleration. This method used the geometric modeling of the particle system to extract the external characteristics of the flame and analyzed the influence of two external forces of gravity and wind force. It also introduced the simplex noise to control the particle behavior, and combined texture mapping, particle collision and other technologies to make sure better realistic quality and high efficiency. Experiments testify that the method can satisfy the requirement of the reality and the real-time of fire simulation, which got more realistic simulation effect. And further improvements had been made compared with the traditional flame simulation method.

articleTitle: Research on the IPv6 Technical Defects and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The current global Internet USES the TCP/IP protocol cluster, the current version is IPv4. The IPv4 is with 32-bit addresses, the maximum number of computers connected to the Internet in the world is 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">32</sup>. With the development of Internet of things, big data and cloud storage and other technologies, the limited address space defined by IPv4 has been exhausted. To expand the address space, the IETF designed the next generation IPv6 to replace IPv4. IPv6 using a 128-bit address length that provides almost unlimited addresses. However, with the development and application of the Internet of things, big data and cloud storage, IPv6 has some shortcomings in its addressing structure design; security and network compatibility, These technologies are gradually applied in recent years, the continuous development of new technologies application show that the IPv6 address structure design ideas have some fatal defects. This paper proposed a route to upgrade the original IPv4 by studying on the structure of IPv6 "spliced address", and point out the defects in the design of IPv6 interface ID and the potential problems such as security holes.

articleTitle: Terminal Sliding Mode Control for Robotic Manipulator Based on Combined Reaching Law
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: A new sliding mode controller is designed in this paper to improve the trajectory tracking performance of robotic manipulator. A combined reaching law is proposed to balance the reaching speed and chattering reduction in the reaching phase, the terminal sliding surface is introduced to improve the convergence rate in the sliding phase. Then the new sliding mode controller is designed based on the combined reaching law and the terminal sliding surface. Simulation results verify the performance of the control law.

articleTitle: Research on Blind Forensics of Large Data Compression Traces in Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to better carry out quasi-blind forensics of large data compression traces in communication, a blind forensics method for large data compression traces in power communication under the Internet of Things of magnitude is proposed. Firstly, the compressed trace features of power communication big data are collected and analyzed, and data noise reduction processing is carried out according to the characteristic collection results. After noise reduction is completed, the compressed trace features are subjected to blind forensics so as to complete comparison and correction of compressed data and realize blind forensics of compressed trace of power communication big data. Finally, the experiment proves that the blind evidence collection method of large data compression traces in power communication under the lightweight Internet of Things has better practicability than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Construction of Feedback Control Model for Auxiliary Facilities Based on Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to better detect and control the operation effect of auxiliary equipment in substation, a feedback control model based on mobile Internet technology is proposed. The feedback parameters can be set by cascade algorithm, and the control process can be optimized according to the feedback parameters. Finally, the feedback control model of auxiliary facilities can be designed. Finally, the design of feedback control model based on mobile Internet technology is verified by experiments. Finally, the experiment proves that the feedback control model based on mobile Internet technology assistant facilities is more practical than the traditional model and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: A Study of Emergency Web Rumors in Weibo Based on LDA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Weibo is an extremely high volume platform for user to post any topic, even though the content may not be true. The abundant content created at real-time contains massive information to identify topics. Such topics can be utilized in numerous ways, such as public opinion mining, marketing and emergency information diffusion. However, in microblogging systems like Weibo, emergency and web rumors often appear together. Facing web rumors, it is difficult for the masses to distinguish between the true and the false, whose opinions are often following the crowd, causing the public opinion crisis. Models, such as LDA topic model, propose algorithms for relating collections of documents to sets of keywords that represent underly topics. Based on this approach, this paper takes the 2017 Taifu Middle School in Sichuan as an example, collects comments of the netizens in Weibo, and analyzes the topics in this emergency. This paper describes the proposed approach, do a case study and propose solutions which contribute to managing web rumors and controlling the spread of rumors in emergencies.

articleTitle: Research on Grassland Classification Intelligent System Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This paper research on Grassland Classification Intelligent System Based on BP Neural Network, and takes the grassland in the Sanjiangyuan area as an example, taking the viewpoint of a grassland expert, including the five aspects of the smear coverage, the proportion of dominant grass species, the proportion of degraded indicator species, the proportion of edible forage grass and the situation of rodents. The main factors affecting grassland degradation were evaluated by BP neural network technology, and get the correct rate of 99.12%, and the test accuracy rate is also above 95%.

articleTitle: Research on the Resource Allocation Control in Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile devices, the demands for data traffic has grown rapidly in recent years. Besides, the indoor mobile users (MUs) often have the experience of poor signal reception problem. The deployment of femtocells is considered as a promising technique to address these issues. However, in the heterogeneous network system, the macro BS will suffer serious interference from the femtocell MUs. Therefore, the macro BS has to protect its macro MUs and charge the interference price from the femtocell MUs. In this paper, we study price-based interference power control for resource allocation in a macro-femto heterogeneous network system.

articleTitle: Design of Ultraviolet Flue Gas Analyzer Based on Recursive Iterative Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to accurately detect the concentration of various elemental gases in flue gas, based on beer-lambert's law and the multivariate superposition of absorbance, this paper proposes a mutually recursive iterative algorithm for solving multi-gas concentration. The algorithm uses different gases to absorb ultraviolet light at 190nm ~ 290nm with different characteristic absorption peaks. According to the degree of absorption of photons by primary and secondary gases, it carries out multiple recursive iterative operations until the difference of concentration between two adjacent gases is less than a specific value. The experimental results show that the measurement error of gas concentration is within 3%, which meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Precise Quality Testing of Sponge City Construction Under Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The traditional detection management system lacks certain stability in practical work. Therefore, big data technology is introduced to put forward the precise quality detection system of sponge city construction project. The hardware design of the system is a functional framework layer created based on the Internet system. On this basis, the system is divided into data processing module, testing function module and engineering management module with the idea of modularity, which is used to test the quality of construction projects, and to complete the design of precise quality testing system for sponge city construction projects under the big data technology. Finally, the test system is built to test the system proposed by big data technology. The experimental results show that the system has strong stability and meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Clustering Algorithm of High Dimension Power Dispatching Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the poor robustness of traditional power dispatching communication data clustering algorithm an intelligent clustering algorithm for heterogeneous high-dimensional power dispatching communication data under explicit rank constraint is proposed. Through data cleaning, integration and matrix calculation, the rank of communication data matrix is obtained, and the preprocessing of communication data is completed. According to the explicit constraint of rank, the cluster of communication data is generated, and the threshold value and other parameters are set. After selecting the cluster heads according to the threshold value, select the same or small difference cluster heads according to the rank constraint to form the data cluster, and complete the intelligent clustering of the communication data. Through the comparison with the traditional clustering algorithm, the simulation results show that the proposed data clustering algorithm is nearly four times more robust and more advantageous than the traditional clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Performance Advertising Deduction System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of online advertising market, major Internet companies are laying out their own online advertising trading platform. Billing system is an important and indispensable part of the whole online advertising transaction process. In order to solve the actual advertising deduction needs of an e-commerce company in China and combine with my own thinking, this paper designs and implements the online advertising transaction deduction system to support the billing needs of the advertising trading platform. The system has the characteristics of scalability, fault tolerance and high availability.

articleTitle: Research on QoS Optimization Method of Wireless Access Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the popularity of the network, the demand for wireless networks is increasing. In wireless networks, the mobility of the network is strong and the variability of data is strong, which makes it more important for users to provide reliable and reliable quality of service for the use of the network. However, the current academic research on network service quality is still not very popular. In order to enable users to obtain high quality of service in the process of using mobile networks, this paper studies the optimization method of service quality of wireless access networks. This paper studies the optimization mechanism and algorithm of QOS from two aspects, and obtains the method of QOS optimization of wireless access network, which promotes the development of network service quality.

articleTitle: Design of Power Monitoring System Based on Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In view of the slow fault warning of three traditional power monitoring systems, namely manual monitoring system, PDN technology and CNSU technology, the design of power monitoring system based on wireless network is proposed. The hardware facilities such as sensors, coordinators and data storage interfaces are optimized to realize the hardware design of power monitoring system. And through the watchdog timer to reduce monitoring stuck ton situation, monitoring video effectively read, and the failure of the data alarm reminder, in order to achieve the software design. Experimental results show that the hardware and software design of the power monitoring system can timely remind the power system failure and reduce the loss of power system failure.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Large Data Fusion Access Method for Distribution Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to ensure the effective operation of distribution communication network, the multi-source large data fusion access method of distribution communication network is innovated and improved. Firstly, by collecting the data features of distribution communication network, extracting the effective far-distance data features, reasonably transforming the heterogeneous feature data according to the collected data features, and effectively realizing the feature fusion access of data after completing the feature transformation. Finally, the experiment proves that the multi-source large data fusion access method of distribution communication network has higher practicability than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on FCS-MPC Control Strategy of Low Predictive Budget NPC/H Five-Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the development and application of microprocessors, discrete state finite control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) has been gradually applied to power electronic systems. Because of its advantages of easy application in non-linear systems, easy handling of multi-conditional constraints, multi-task objectives, multi-degree-of-freedom optimization problems, strong adaptability and robustness, FCS-MPC has brought new ideas and methods for traditional power electronics and power transmission control, which is conducive to further improving the dynamic and static control performance of variable frequency speed control system, and has attracted widespread attention of scholars and industry all over the world. In this paper, NPC/H bridge Five-Level Inverter is taken as the research object. Firstly, NPC/H Five-Level Inverter and FCS-MPC control system are analyzed. In view of the challenges faced by FCS-MPC control system, a simplified FCS-MPC strategy with low predictive computation is adopted to solve the problem. The method is not only simple, but also save the cost of hardware equipment and have better economic benefits. So as to achieve a low forecast budget.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Machine Learning for Distribution Network Fusion Control
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of test sample data of distribution communication network fusion control, an improved machine learning technology for distribution communication network fusion control was established. The distribution communication network port is identified based on the network protocol, and the number of neurons controlled by the fusion of the distribution communication network is determined according to the sample information sent by the port number. After the feature selection layer by layer, the traffic characteristics of the machine learning protocol are selected according to the neural network structure. Moreover, the Relief algorithm is used to calculate the actual number of machine learning protocols and realize the design of improved machine learning technology for the fusion control of power distribution and communication networks. Compared with other three traditional techniques, it is concluded that this technique has obvious advantages in sample processing accuracy.

articleTitle: Damaged Image Restoration Based on Improved Criminisi Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Criminisi algorithm has been widely used to repair damaged images, but the algorithm still has problems such as unreasonable priority selection algorithm and high error rate of fixed sample block matching. In view of these existing problems, based on the Crminisi algorithm, this paper adds edge terms, improves the priority algorithm, and sorts the image filling order reasonably. Experiments show that the modified Criminisi algorithm can overcome the shortcomings of the image discontinuity after repair, and can improve the quality of broken image restoration.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation on Resistivity Measurement in Downhole
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In this paper, a downhole in-situ experimental technique is proposed to measure rock physical parameters by placing a measuring probe into the borehole. Based on COMSOL multi-physics finite element software, the five detector structures were simulated and the structural parameters of the detector were determined according to the detection depth performance index. The experimental measurement of the probe in solution and rock was carried out by constructing a physical simulation experiment platform. The measurement of the probe in nine different salinity solutions showed that the resistivity probe constant K and the measured voltage were consistent with the numerical simulation results. Further, the probe was measured in the rock, and the results showed that the resistivity measured in the hole and the drilled column was measured. The resistivity of the plug core is less than 5%, and the result lays the foundation for the development of the downhole in-situ experimental measurement system.

articleTitle: Application Research on Optimizing the Semantic Similarity of B-U Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Semantic similarity is widely used in many fields such as information retrieval, information extraction, natural language classification, semantic understanding, and machine translation based on word meaning. Especially in recent years, with the rapid development of computer technology, the means of knowledge structure processing is more complicated and diversified, which promotes the rapid development of semantic similarity calculation methods. Aiming at the advantages and disadvantages of these three traditional methods of semantic similarity calculation, an improved method in the paper is presented by using the distance as the basis of the calculation model and combining the two key decision factors of the content and attributes of the information.

articleTitle: Dimensions and Construction of E-Commerce Network Security
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: E-commerce plays an important role in China's economic development, and in the future, E-commerce will have more room for development. However, e-commerce relies on the Internet, and network security issues related to the Internet pose a serious threat to e-commerce transactions. Therefore, from the perspective of network security strategy, this paper will analyze the security system of China's e-commerce network, and then propose strategies to enhance the security of China's e-commerce network, to provide protection for the rapid development of China's e-commerce field.

articleTitle: Research on Spectrum Fitting and Extraction of Power Grid Communication Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor power spectrum fitting and extraction of current signals, such as poor power grid communication, a power spectrum fitting and extraction technology of power grid communication signals based on big data technology is proposed. By extracting the parameter characteristics of the power grid communication signal, the power wave frequency of the signal is calculated, and the power spectrum fitting value is calculated according to the wave frequency fluctuation characteristics, so that the power spectrum fitting extraction of the power grid communication signal is finally realized. Finally, the experiment proves that the power spectrum fitting and extraction technology of power grid communication signals based on big data technology is obviously improved compared with the traditional method and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Research on the Center of Gravity of High-Voltage Line Tower Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to overcome the positioning error of target gravity center caused by non-uniform and under-sampling methods of traditional high-voltage line tower group, based on the traditional calculation method of target gravity center, the concept of image graphics was introduced in the background of cloud computing, and a method to determine the target gravity center of high-voltage line tower group based on cloud computing was proposed. Firstly, the target is mapped to binary image according to the information of sampling point position and radiation value of high-voltage line tower group. In the mapping process, the boundary, internal attribute and relative relation of the original image remain unchanged, so as to determine the target shape. Before calculating the center of gravity of image region, preprocessing is carried out to eliminate the imperfection of image boundary. The target boundary point is discretized, the center of gravity of the irregular graph is obtained, and then the position of the center of gravity of the target in the field of view is obtained according to the mapping rule. The method can also be used to locate the center of gravity of multiple targets or interferences in the field of view when they can be separated. Simulation results show that the accuracy of the target gravity center of the method based on cloud computing is significantly better than that of the traditional method.

articleTitle: Special Waveform Analysis in Detecting Dynamic Fluid Level of Oil Well
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: A slice of special waveforms often appear in the echo signal of oil well dynamic fluid level detected by acoustic wave, but there is no relevant research on that at present. In order to deeply study these special waveforms, this paper studies and analyzes them by combining the theory of acoustic wave detection with several special waveforms collected in the process of acoustic wave detection of dynamic fluid level. Through the field verification, the relationship between the several special waveforms and the actual situation is determined, which provides another way to judge the down hole and the field situation, and has certain practical value in the future.

articleTitle: DDOS Defense Strategy in Software Definition Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the advent of the network economy and the network society, the network will enter a ubiquitous and omnipresent situation. Economic, cultural, military and social life will strongly depend on the network, while network security issues have become a common concern of all countries in the world. DDOS attack is undoubtedly one of the greatest threats to network security and the defense against DDOS attack is very important. In this paper, the principle of DDOS attack is summarized from the defensive purpose. Then the attack prevention in software definition network is analyzed, and the source, intermediate network, victim and distributed defense strategies are elaborated.

articleTitle: Study on Blade Server Database in Intelligent Emergency Support System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This paper presented the idea of blade-server general knowledge database model in applying object-oriented and realization principle oriented Intelligent Emergency Management Support System(IEMSS), which is combined with the general knowledge database based on GIS spatial decision-making support system as the core of crisis management and emergency rescues. IEMSS has caused the traditional spatial decision-making support system to suffer profound change, as it integrate the general knowledge database, the blade server base, the general knowledge base into GIS, and can realize GIS and the blade server base as well as the knowledge base to bond tightly, as well as enable the traditional spatial decision-making support system to have a characteristics of intelligence and scientificalness. Finally, the design of IEMSS database and the functions of its modules were discussed and a concrete case study of IEMSS was also described to show the practical use of the system in which the emergency disposal for expansion of hazardous chemicals has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Load Distribution Planning of Power Grid Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor effect of power grid load-sharing operation planning, a power grid load-sharing operation planning method based on the Internet of Things is proposed through investigation and research. First of all, the calculation of the standard parameters for safe load distribution of the power grid is carried out, the characteristic parameters of operation rules are collected, and the characteristic parameters are compared and corrected according to the standard load parameters, thus realizing the load distribution operation planning of the power grid. Finally, the experiment proves that the load-sharing operation planning method based on the Internet of Things has higher accuracy and safety than the traditional method, and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation of Learning Resources Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The campus learning resource sharing platform provides a platform for students to share and exchange learning resources. Providing personalized recommendations on demand when users log in will provide users with a lot of convenience. In this thesis, the clustering algorithm is first used to classify users. Secondly, the classified users are analyzed according to their grades and faculties, and personalized recommendations are given, which greatly facilitates users and saves them.

articleTitle: Research on the Address Structure of Decimal Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Due to the limited network address resources of IPv4, which restricts the application and development of the Internet, The Internet Engineering Task Force has designed an IPv6 protocol to replace IPv4. The use of IPv6 solves the problem of the number of network address resources, but its scale also brings difficulties for security detection. For example, the query of massive addresses becomes more complex, making the security protection of IPv6 face challenges. Chinese researchers have proposed a decimal network address architecture, referred to as IPV9. Based on the study of IPv4 and IPv6 address structure, this paper designs the standards of the decimal network address structure, including IPV9 unicast address structure, anycast address structure and multicast address structure, which provides a solid foundation for the later decimal network research.

articleTitle: Acquisition Terminal Status Evaluation Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In view of the potential fault risk in the field operation of the acquisition terminal, there is still no effective method to make a reasonable evaluation on its running state. In this paper, we pick up the important influence factors of terminal running state and divide them into four aspects by using the data record of MDS system, electricity information collection system and SG186 information system. Then the fuzzy theory and analytic hierarchy process are used to construct judgement matrix. At last, we establish the running state analysis model which can be accurate to evaluate the running state of the acquisition terminal. At the end of this paper, we use a concrete example to illustrate our assessment process and get good results. Using this method to analyze the operation state of the acquisition terminal can effectively monitor the operation state of the acquisition terminal, which is of great significance to the field operation and maintenance work.

articleTitle: Research on Shift Control of Automatic Transmission of Semi-Automatic Driving Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of a large amount of strong electromagnetic and environmental vibration noise in the shift signal of motor vehicles, and considering the demand of real-time performance and hardware performance, based on the discrete wavelet algorithm of minimum bandwidth, a simplified wavelet decomposition layer determination method suitable for engineering implementation is proposed. Then the wavelet coefficients of each layer are classified by the initial threshold value, and the adaptive iterative determination algorithm of the threshold value of each layer is designed based on the modulus and mean variance of the mean difference of various coefficients in each layer, and the quantization function of the threshold value is improved. Simulation comparison test and application test results show that the algorithm has a good effect on noise reduction and is suitable for the detection and noise reduction of related signals of motor vehicles.

articleTitle: Intelligent Location of Data Center Linkage Path Under Non-Outage Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: According to the analysis of problems such as inaccurate intelligent positioning of data center linkage path, an intelligent positioning method of data center linkage path under non-outage maintenance is proposed.
