The optimal path in data center linkage structure is selected by combining neural network technology, and the safety coefficient in path nodes is calculated, so as to strengthen the safety coefficient of target path, check positioning errors, and finally realize the optimal selection and intelligent positioning of data center linkage path. Finally, experiments prove that the intelligent positioning technology of data center linkage path under non-outage maintenance is greatly improved compared with the traditional positioning technology.

articleTitle: The Design of Remote Motor Control System Based on the Two Server Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The scheme of two server programs based is proposed in order to solve the security issues of the control information network. And the encryption algorithm which improves certification accuracy is proposed, too. The remote control based on the control information network is a web service, through building the platform of web-based remote motor control, implementing the remote speed control of motor by the technology of JSP. The method virilities the feasibility and safety of two server programs in the control information network. These methods provide a new way to integrate the control network and information network, and to lay a solid foundation for the development of the control network.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Particle Algorithm in Wireless Network Power Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: A power allocation algorithm based on route security connection probability in the paper is proposed. Through the improvement of the particle algorithm, the particle swarm with the largest safe capacity is selected to realize the relatively safe low-power routing energy-saving scheme. The algorithm not only improves the security of information transmission by maximizing the probability of routing secure connections, but also reduces the power consumption of the system. Not only that, because the reduced computational complexity, it has very good achievability and scalability, and is equally applicable to very large networks. The simulation test found that the performance comparison results from the total power of the route transmission and the probability of the secure connection can prove the superiority of the research scheme.

articleTitle: Development and Realization of "Xi Ma" Moving Target Detection and Tracking
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In recent years, marathons have been held frequently in Xi'an, Xi' an marathon for the promotion of urban visibility and the development of urban culture have played a positive role in promoting. With the development of computer vision and image coding technology, the detection and tracking of moving targets has become a hot topic in the field of research. The target detection and tracking system based on "Xi Ma" movement combines XI' an marathon with moving target detection and tracking technology, which provides an effective solution to the problems such as the detection and trajectory tracking of marathon athletes in real competition. The system realizes the construction of the whole frame using Electron frame technology, and realizes the detection and tracking function of the target in the system by means of inter-frame difference method, regional-based convolution neural network and CamShift algorithm. Thus, it provides an effective scheme for the detection and trajectory tracking of marathon runners in real competitions.

Author Keywords: The Detection and Tracking of Moving Targets

articleTitle: The Reliability Study of Engine Fault Diagnosis Parameter Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Fault diagnosis technology is an important means to monitor the safe operation of aviation engine, and has become a research hotspot in aviation power technology field. The traditional fault diagnosis method USES the real-time data of sensor parameters for analysis and diagnosis, which does not take into account the reliability of parameter data and historical diagnostic information. At first, this paper puts forward the empirical iteration algorithm is applied in determining weights each diagnosis parameter value, and then to the credibility of the weighted data before diagnosis made to eliminate or reduce the weight of these outliers, finally according to the data fusion of each parameter probability value to judge whether the engine failed, after is weighted by the credibility, can see obviously reduces the failure rate of false positives and improve the accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Prediction of Time-of-Use Price on Power Sale
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy forecasting of traditional Time-of-Use (ToU) price, a key intelligent price forecasting technology based on Internet is proposed. Taking the historical ToU price data on the Internet as input, the middle pass filter function and wavelet decomposition are used to preprocess the historical data. After converting the data into values in the [0, 1] interval by using the normalization method, input the neural network. Using the input data, the neural network is trained to determine the weight of the forecast, complete the forecast of ToU price, and output the forecast result. By comparing the two technologies and the real value, the relative error of the designed intelligent prediction technology is 1/5 of the relative error of the traditional prediction technology, indicating that the designed intelligent prediction technology is more accurate.

articleTitle: Study on Transient Stability of Low Voltage Distribution Network Based On IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The transient stability of the flexible load disturbance of the low-voltage distribution network is one of the important reasons affecting the low-voltage transmission. The traditional analysis process of the transient stability of the flexible load disturbance of the low-voltage distribution network stays on the theoretical calculation, which is quite different from the actual value. Therefore, a study on the transient stability of the flexible load disturbance of the low-voltage distribution network based on the Internet of things is proposed. Build flexible load disturbance transient stability model of low voltage distribution network, the model to simulate the transient voltage instability of scenario, the characteristics of low voltage distribution network of small disturbance and the time-varying characteristic of large disturbance is analyzed, in order to realize network flexible load disturbance transient stability study, and gives the selected grid transient voltage loss of rapid reconstruction method. A small disturbance voltage stability analysis example is designed to prove the experimental accuracy.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization Design of Suspension System Based on Spatial Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In view of the uncertainty influence of spatial structure parameters of suspension system for vehicle dynamic performance, a robust optimization design of suspension system had been performed based on Taguchi method. A vehicle model was built to carry out the simulation analysis. By the simulation data, the key factors for vehicle dynamic performance were gotten and the design variables were chosen. The design variables include 6 spatial structure parameters of suspension system, such as the kingpin length, the upper arm length of suspension system, the pull arm length, etc, and 2 noise factors, the kingpin inclination angle and caster. The optimization objectives included the vehicle vertical acceleration, the wheel side slip and the vehicle roll angle. The optimization results were shown that the variance of optimization objective was decreased and the robustness of vehicle dynamic performance was improved.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Control of Charge and Discharge of Lithium Battery
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The charging and discharging process of lithium ion battery is one of the important factors affecting its service life. In the process of charging and discharging, there are problems such as long charging time, high temperature rise and serious gas evolution. Based on the analysis of the existing control, the intelligent control of lithium ion battery is proposed. It USES high voltage IGBT device bridge circuit and zero voltage phase shift control to charge and discharge the lithium ion battery. In the MATLAB simulation environment, a lithium ion battery charging and discharging circuit based on the bi-directional DC/DC converter is built, and MATLAB/ Simulink is used for simulation. The results show that the bi-directional DC/DC converter can charge and discharge the lithium battery quickly and reliably and stabilize the output voltage, thus improving the service life of the battery.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Control of Hierarchical Feedback Based On Mobile IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor operation of substation equipment control feedback system, the research and application of hierarchical feedback intelligent control system based on mobile Internet of Things technology are proposed. Combined with DSPTMS320F chip, the hardware configuration of the system is optimized, and different warning lights are set for different levels of feedback information, so as to select an effective control scheme. The software of the system information is optimized by combining the feature acquisition algorithm, the system operation process is simplified, and the research and application of the hierarchical feedback intelligent control system are realized. Finally, the experiment proves that the hierarchical feedback intelligent control system based on mobile IoT is more practical than the traditional control system.

articleTitle: Monitoring for Health Status of Communication Equipment Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor monitoring effect of communication equipment health status, a communication equipment health status monitoring method based on Internet of Things technology is proposed. Through optimizing the monitoring structure of communication equipment, monitoring values of different structural modules in different communication equipment are divided, and health state parameter algorithms are respectively set according to the division results, and the health state of the equipment is compared and corrected according to the calculation results, so that accurate monitoring of the health state of the communication equipment is realized. Finally, the experiment proves that the health monitoring method of communication equipment based on Internet of Things technology proposed in this paper is more practical than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Vibration Detection Terminal for Bridge Deck
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Through the detection of bridge deck vibration, the information of passing vehicles can be obtained indirectly, so as to grasp the dynamics of the enemy. In this paper, a micro-power wireless vibration detection terminal is designed. In order to reduce power consumption, the terminal uses two sensors, one is the spring switch, the other is the acceleration sensor. When no vehicle passes by, the terminal is in a dormant state. As the vehicle passes by, the spring switch wakes up the CPU and the acceleration sensor to collect data. ZigBee network for data transmission has the advantages of low power consumption and ad hoc network. Experiments show that the average power consumption of the terminal is less than 7 mw. In theory, if the terminal is powered by 3.6V, 36Ah lithium batteries, it can work for at least two years.

articleTitle: Research on Low Current Grounding Fault Recovery Under Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor recovery of small current grounding fault in cloth distribution network, the design of small current grounding fault recovery system for cloud computing distribution network is proposed. By optimizing the hardware configuration of the system, improving the security of the small current branch line in the distribution network, improving the safety of the system, in order to ensure the stable operation of the system, combined with the gain algorithm to calculate the fault parameters, optimize the fault recovery process according to the fault parameters. Finally, the Research on Low Current Grounding Fault Recovery System of Distribution network under Cloud Computing is realized. Finally, it is proved by experiments that the small current grounding fault recovery system of cloud computing distribution network has more accurate fault detection and recovery effect.

articleTitle: Research on Academic Analysis Based on Hadoop Platform Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet+, it is still necessary for users to extract valuable data from massive data using classical algorithms. Based on the Hadoop platform, this paper uses collaborative filtering algorithm to study the overall employment situation of IT industry across the country. It has important reference value for college students working in the IT industry, such as working place, salary, skill points, etc. The results of study analysis have certain theoretical research significance in talent cultivation in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Distributed Concept Lattice Feature Matching Analysis in Large Data Set
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To solve the problems of low accuracy and long time-consuming in feature matching of concept lattices, a distributed feature matching method of concept lattices in large data sets is proposed. By collecting the features of Distributed Concept Lattice and preprocessing the feature matching according to the results of feature acquisition, in order to ensure the accuracy of matching results, the classification criteria of features in large data sets are standardized. The feature matching of distributed concept lattices is completed according to the specification results. Experiments show that feature matching of Distributed Concept Lattices in large data sets is more accurate and time-consuming than traditional feature matching methods.

articleTitle: Research on Differential Game Security Under Internal Attacks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The existing computer, information and communication technologies could not meet the needs of network security of Cyberspace. In order to solve this problem, many scholars have proposed many research methods. In the paper, according to the method of differential game, a non-cooperative differential game model, included gain and differential game model, and the calculation of optimal strategy, was presented to solve the Cyberspace security issues, which would effectively detect the attack from malicious nodes and apply a minimum of resources. The simulation experiment results showed that the model had good performance on probability stability and time efficiency; meanwhile, it could ensure the minimal resource consumption.

articleTitle: Hierarchical WLAN Security Risk Assessment Based on D-S Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Security problem in WLAN has always been a hot topic, but traditional assessment methods are often not suitable for WLAN. By deeply analyzing the typical characteristics and security attributes of WLAN, a hierarchical security risk assessment model is established. First analytic hierarchy process is used to determine weight of risk assessment index in the model, and then improved D-S combination rules of evidence theory is used to fuse risk assessment indexes from bottom to top, and eliminate the conflict between different evaluation values, next final risk value of WLAN is obtained with a comprehensive consideration of various factors including asset value, vulnerability severity, and threat frequency. Finally simulation results verify feasibility and validity of the proposed method, which can provide objective basis of decision and pointed guidance for security management of WLAN.

articleTitle: Analysis of Stock Market Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This paper uses SPSS tools and factor analysis theory to make a comprehensive evaluation of the company's stock performance. Data come from 10 representative listed companies in different industries. Because of the high weight and strong correlation of the original data, it is impossible to obtain the original data directly. Therefore, it is necessary to reduce the number of variables, which not only completes the dimension reduction statistics, but also doesn't cause a large number of data loss, so that the factors of reorganization of the original variables ensure the weak linear relationship between them. Through data standardization, factor analysis and factor analysis, factor analysis model is obtained. From the final model, we can also see that in the comprehensive evaluation model, the proportion of comprehensive factors of enterprise profitability is the highest, and the proportion of comprehensive factors reflecting inventory turnover rate is the smallest, but the proportion of the four comprehensive factors is not much different. On the basis of practical analysis, the conclusion is reasonable, and the company's performance can be seen from the point of score.
